description: This Java class handles JSON deserialization and validation for address commands in the Fineract platform, including validation logic based on configuration data and client context.

classes.name: AddressCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: Handles JSON deserialization and validation for address-related commands, utilizing configuration data and supporting validation for create/update operations.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for address update operations.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for address creation, considering if it's from a new client.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of JSON input, checking for required fields, supported parameters, and regex validation based on configuration.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws validation exception if any validation errors are present.
